title: 第23章 还有高手第24章 孵化夜玄的第二契约妖宠
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 他没有停止，继续抡起碗大拳头往下捶击。
拳拳用力。
砰！
场面血肉溅射，骨骼夹杂血肉爆裂动静听的几名少年胆战心惊，接连后退。
渐渐的。
黑袍鸦面督察四肢停止动弹，彻底垂落不动…
数息后，杜刚起身，像是没发生事般擦了擦染血拳头。
那名二阶御兽师鸦面督察，竟被他用一对拳头活活砸死。
面具在重击下爆裂四溅，露出下面那张扭曲变形的陌生面孔，整颗头颅被巨力砸进泥地，像一颗熟透的瓜果般凹陷崩裂。
唯有断裂脖颈还倔强的挺出地面，咕噜喷血。
“刚，刚哥，还没问完话…”
刘海少年咽了咽唾沫。
“再抓一个就是。”
杜刚意味深长，双目血丝渐退。
一行人唯杜刚马首是瞻，隐遁黑暗离去。
鼻岛范围很大，想找出囚徒，有时还得靠运气。
时间流逝，夜色如墨化开，东方既白时分，紫气东来。
众鸦面督察默契停止搜寻，如受惊的夜鸦群驾驭妖宠腾起，鸦羽黑袍在疾驰中撕开朦胧雾气，向着临时聚集地方向汇聚。
按照规则，白天禁止杀戮，给予小囚徒们喘息之机。
“奇怪，我们的人是不是有点少。”
聚集地火堆边，一名鸦面督察眉头皱起喃语。
“可能距离有些远，再等等。”
“也对。”
晌午时分，赶来的鸦面督察几乎都已到齐。
其中包括十名队长级。
“人呢？”
一号鸦面队长有些不悦，居高俯瞰众鸦面督察。
百名鸦面督察，此时回来的只有六十七人。
众鸦面督察面面相觑，彼此同样感到纳闷。
纳闷怎会空缺如此多的人。
不应该啊。
content_en:
;;
He didn't stop and continued to hit the bowl with his big fist.
Punch hard.
"Bang!
Bang!
Bang…”
The scene was filled with blood and flesh splattering, bones mixed with flesh and blood exploding. Several young people who heard the sound were frightened and retreated one after another.
Gradually.
The black-robed crow-faced inspector's limbs stopped moving and fell completely motionless...
After a few breaths, Du Gang stood up and wiped his bloody fist as if nothing happened.
The second-level beastmaster Crow-faced Inspector was actually beaten to death by him with a pair of fists.
The mask exploded and splashed under the heavy blow, revealing the distorted and unfamiliar face underneath. The whole head was smashed into the mud with great force, denting and cracking like a ripe fruit.
Only the broken neck still stubbornly stood out from the ground, and Gulu spurted blood.
"Gang, Brother Gang, I haven't finished asking yet..."
The boy with bangs swallowed.
"Just catch one more."
Du Gang had a profound meaning, and the bloodshot eyes gradually receded.
"Yes..."
Only Du Gang, a group of people, looked up immediately and left in the darkness.
“…”
Bi Island is very large, and sometimes you have to rely on luck to find the prisoner.
As time goes by, the night turns like ink, and when the east becomes white, purple air comes from the east.
The crow-faced inspectors tacitly stopped the search, and like a flock of frightened night crows riding on their demon pets, the crow-feathered black robes tore through the hazy mist as they galloped, converging in the direction of the temporary gathering place.
According to the rules, killing is prohibited during the day to give the young prisoners a chance to breathe.
"It's strange, there are a little few of us."
Beside the fire at the gathering place, a crow-faced inspector frowned and murmured.
"It may be a little far away, please wait."
"That's right."
“…”
At noon, almost all the crow-faced inspectors who arrived were here.
This includes ten captains.
"Where are the people?"
Captain Crow Face No. 1 was a little displeased, overlooking all the Crow Face inspectors from a high position.
Of the hundred crow-faced inspectors, only sixty-seven returned at this time.
The crow-faced inspectors looked at each other, feeling equally puzzled.
I wonder how there are so many vacancies.
It shouldn't be.
